meta_description_en: Editorial for Outlet issue #11 (July 1988): delays due to printer failure, advice on submitting contributions in digital format, and an overview of programs in this issue.
meta_description_ru: Вступительное слово редакции Outlet №11 (июль 1988): причины задержки тиража, призыв присылать файлы на дискетах вместо бумажных распечаток и краткий обзор программ номера.
body_en_plain:
Well, we are now entering a new
promotional phase with OUTLET to
try to boost the readership up a
bit so you should see one or two
modest advertisements appearing
regularly now we hope. The more
readers - the more contributions
of ideas as well as software!

We had a crisis just before last
month's duplication run - Ron's
printer broke down completely so
he couldn't do the labelling. He
hung on for a few days but the
repair shop he'd taken it to let
him down so he had to mail blank
labels to me for printing which,
coupled with a return delay in a
first class packet of about five
days, meant the whole issue went
out very late.

The printer failure also meant
Ron could not reply promptly to
inquiries and deal with other
correspondence. Sorry,everybody!
Ron will now print up a stock of
labels ahead of time to avoid
part of the problem if this ever
happens again.

We try to avoid any boring rules
in OUTLET and so invite contri-
butions of programs and letters
etc. in virtually any form but
we do appreciate a text file of
some sort where possible rather
than hard copy. We'd rather have
hard copy than nothing at all
but it obviously means that time
spent on typing in text from a
piece of paper means time not
spent on writing programs and
other projects to enhance OUTLET
so, if you can, without too much
hassle, try to send in a text
file.Any discs or cartridges are
returned - promise! Remember, if
you are sending in a disc or a
cartridge for your next issue of
OUTLET, you can use that - it
won't be erased if you mark the
order form.

We have had several cases where
a blank disc or cartridge has
been sent in for the next OUTLET
together with a lengthy program
listing printed out from some-
one's Spectrum onto a sheet of
paper for us to type back into
our Spectrum!We're both often at
our wit's end with the amount of
work we have to get through each
day to keep OUTLET ticking over
so help us out! Support your
local editor!

Inquisitive microdrive owners
may occasionally see the message
"statement lost" when breaking
in to some OUTLET programs. This
is where we've taken out lines
that switch off FAILSAFE to save
a little memory. No harm is done
so just ignore the messages.

Let's look at the month's items:
TK50 is a "toolkit" type program
with over 20 utilities included!
DOODLE is a mini pattern maker
and CHECKOUT looks at one of our
pre-OUTLET packages: UTILITY "A"
which a few people have asked
about.OUTCLASS is another in the
"reference-style" format and is
by way of introduction to BASIC
and also to help non-programmers
understand some of the terms and
expressions they see in OUTLET.
ADDACAT adds a CAT function to
the HISOFT assembler if you have
it.

WINDOWINDER is a great window-
scrolling utility. We said last
month it would be on the "A"
cartridge but we ran out of room

so had to move it to "B".

Also on "B" and disc is a long
DRIVECHAT about microdrives from
APPLIED TECHNOLOGY; TO THE TOP,
a football management-type game;
DATOTAZ which moves BASIC string
DATA to Tasword two format and
FURNISHER which will let you
look at endless re-arrangements
of your furniture without the
physical effort. As promised,
there's also a fresh picture to
load into JIG!BLOX in Issue 2 or
the demo sampler. Prizes! Fame!
Glory!

If you want to print-out the
CONTENTS for reference the list
of programs follows on the next
page:-

 OUTLET NO.11 CONTENTS, JULY,88
 ------------------------------
      A                B

TK50 INFO      DRIVECHAT
                (Applied Tech.)

TK50 TOOLKIT   WINDOWINDER

DOODLE         TO THE TOP!
                  (football)

CHECKOUT       DATOTAZ
(Utility A)

OUTCLASS       FURNISHER
(BASIC intro)

ADDACAT INFO   JIG!BLOX PICTURE

ADDACAT (to HISOFT)

We're trying to get together an
alphabetical index for the year
next month (yes! we're one year
old!) and this may also print
out in categories and be upated
each month with MERGEable DATA.

Enjoy the mag!


       Ron & Brian Cavers
       CHEZRON   SOFTWARE
      605 Loughborough Road
   Birstall, Leicester LE4 4NJ
   Prestel Mailbox:- 014703943.

Что ж, сейчас мы начинаем новый
этап рекламы OUTLET, пытаясь
немного расширить круг наших
читателей, так что теперь вы,
надеемся, будете регулярно
видеть одну-две скромные рекламы.
Чем больше читателей — тем больше
присылаемых идей и программ!

Прямо перед тиражированием
прошлого номера у нас случился
кризис: у Ron'а напрочь сломался
принтер, и он не мог напечатать
наклейки. Он подождал пару дней,
но ремонтная мастерская, куда он
его отдал, подвела его, так что
ему пришлось выслать чистые
наклейки мне почтой. Это, плюс
задержка посылки первого класса
примерно на пять дней, привело к
тому, что весь номер вышел с
большим опозданием.

Поломка принтера также означала,
что Ron не мог вовремя отвечать
на запросы и разбирать остальную
корреспонденцию. Простите нас!
Теперь Ron напечатает запас
наклеек впрок, чтобы избежать
хотя бы части проблем, если это
повторится.

Мы стараемся избегать скучных
правил в OUTLET и поэтому рады
материалам — программам, письмам
и т.д. — практически в любом
виде, но по возможности пред-
почитаем текстовый файл на диске
распечатке на бумаге. Распечатка
лучше, чем ничего, но время,
потраченное на перепечатывание
текста с листа бумаги — это время,
не потраченное на написание
программ и другие проекты для
улучшения OUTLET. Так что если
можете без лишних хлопот — шлите
текстовый файл. Все диски и
картриджи мы возвращаем — честно!
Помните: если вы шлете диск или
картридж для следующего номера
OUTLET, можно использовать его же:
мы его не сотрем, если вы
поставите отметку в бланке заказа.

Было несколько случаев, когда
чистый диск или картридж для
следующего OUTLET присылали
вместе с длиннющим листингом
программы, распечатанным с чьего-
то Спектрума на бумагу, чтобы мы
набирали его обратно в наш
Спектрум! Мы оба порой просто с ног
сбиваемся от объема работы,
которую приходится делать каждый
день, чтобы OUTLET продолжал жить,
так что помогите нам! Поддержите
родную редакцию!

Любознательные владельцы
микродрайвов могут иногда видеть
сообщение "statement lost" при
прерывании некоторых программ
OUTLET. Это происходит там, где
мы убрали строки, отключающие
FAILSAFE, ради экономии памяти.
Ничего страшного нет, просто
игнорируйте эти сообщения.

Посмотрим на материалы номера:
TK50 — программа типа "toolkit",
содержащая более 20 утилит!
DOODLE — мини-генератор узоров,
а CHECKOUT рассматривает один из
наших до-OUTLET'овских пакетов:
UTILITY "A", о котором некоторые
спрашивали. OUTCLASS — еще одна
статья в формате справочника,
вводная по Бейсику, призванная
помочь непрограммистам понять
термины и выражения, встречаю-
щиеся в OUTLET. ADDACAT добавит
функцию CAT в ассемблер HISOFT,
если он у вас есть.

WINDOWINDER — отличная утилита
для скроллинга окон. В прошлом
месяце мы говорили, что она будет
на картридже "A", но нам не
хватило места,

и пришлось перенести ее на "B".

Также на "B" и на диске: большая
DRIVECHAT о микродрайвах от
APPLIED TECHNOLOGY; TO THE TOP —
игра в жанре футбольного менед-
жера; DATOTAZ, переводящая
строковые DATA Бейсика в формат

бесконечные перестановки мебели

загрузки в JIG!BLOX из Выпуска 2

Если вы хотите распечатать

body_en:
## Editorial

Well, we are now entering a new promotional phase with OUTLET to try to boost the readership up a bit so you should see one or two modest advertisements appearing regularly now we hope. The more readers - the more contributions of ideas as well as software!

We had a crisis just before last month's duplication run - Ron's printer broke down completely so he couldn't do the labelling. He hung on for a few days but the repair shop he'd taken it to let him down so he had to mail blank labels to me for printing which, coupled with a return delay in a first class packet of about five days, meant the whole issue went out very late.

The printer failure also meant Ron could not reply promptly to inquiries and deal with other correspondence. Sorry, everybody! Ron will now print up a stock of labels ahead of time to avoid part of the problem if this ever happens again.

We try to avoid any boring rules in OUTLET and so invite contributions of programs and letters etc. in virtually any form but we do appreciate a text file of some sort where possible rather than hard copy. We'd rather have hard copy than nothing at all but it obviously means that time spent on typing in text from a piece of paper means time not spent on writing programs and other projects to enhance OUTLET so, if you can, without too much hassle, try to send in a text file. Any discs or cartridges are returned - promise! Remember, if you are sending in a disc or a cartridge for your next issue of OUTLET, you can use that - it won't be erased if you mark the order form.

We have had several cases where a blank disc or cartridge has been sent in for the next OUTLET together with a lengthy program listing printed out from someone's Spectrum onto a sheet of paper for us to type back into our Spectrum! We're both often at our wit's end with the amount of work we have to get through each day to keep OUTLET ticking over so help us out! Support your local editor!

Inquisitive microdrive owners may occasionally see the message "statement lost" when breaking in to some OUTLET programs. This is where we've taken out lines that switch off FAILSAFE to save a little memory. No harm is done so just ignore the messages.

Let's look at the month's items:

TK50 is a "toolkit" type program with over 20 utilities included! DOODLE is a mini pattern maker and CHECKOUT looks at one of our pre-OUTLET packages: UTILITY "A" which a few people have asked about. OUTCLASS is another in the "reference-style" format and is by way of introduction to BASIC and also to help non-programmers understand some of the terms and expressions they see in OUTLET. ADDACAT adds a CAT function to the HISOFT assembler if you have it.

WINDOWINDER is a great window-scrolling utility. We said last month it would be on the "A" cartridge but we ran out of room so had to move it to "B".

Also on "B" and disc is a long DRIVECHAT about microdrives from APPLIED TECHNOLOGY; TO THE TOP, a football management-type game; DATOTAZ which moves BASIC string DATA to Tasword two format and FURNISHER which will let you look at endless re-arrangements of your furniture without the physical effort. As promised, there's also a fresh picture to load into JIG!BLOX in Issue 2 or the demo sampler. Prizes! Fame! Glory!

If you want to print-out the CONTENTS for reference the list of programs follows on the next page:-

```text
 OUTLET NO.11 CONTENTS, JULY,88
 ------------------------------
      A                B

TK50 INFO      DRIVECHAT
                (Applied Tech.)

TK50 TOOLKIT   WINDOWINDER

DOODLE         TO THE TOP!
                  (football)

CHECKOUT       DATOTAZ
(Utility A)

OUTCLASS       FURNISHER
(BASIC intro)

ADDACAT INFO   JIG!BLOX PICTURE

ADDACAT (to HISOFT)
```

We're trying to get together an alphabetical index for the year next month (yes! we're one year old!) and this may also print out in categories and be upated each month with MERGEable DATA.

Enjoy the mag!

```text
       Ron & Brian Cavers
       CHEZRON   SOFTWARE
      605 Loughborough Road
   Birstall, Leicester LE4 4NJ
   Prestel Mailbox:- 014703943.
```
